purpose: Durable cover-production authority for Echoes of a Forgotten War. Cover recipes live in data/shows/echoes-forgotten-war-s1/covers.json; this file governs scoped visual reference use for masthead and trade-dress continuity.

authority.issueSpecificRecipe: The assembled selected EFW_S1E##_COVER recipe controls the issue-specific selling image, cast, composition, spoiler ceiling, and exact cover lettering.
authority.tradeDressReference: After approval, production/references/echoes-forgotten-war/covers/issue-01-cover.jpg controls masthead and trade-dress pixels for Issues 2-8.
authority.characterIdentity: production/references/echoes-forgotten-war/visual-reference-pack.json and assembler-visible characters.json control recurring character identity.
rules: Issue 1 is the trade-dress bootstrap cover and does not require a prior cover pixel reference.
After Issue 1 cover approval, persist the exact approved pixels at production/references/echoes-forgotten-war/covers/issue-01-cover.jpg.
Before generating any Issue 2-8 cover, retrieve and visually inspect the actual Issue 1 cover pixels. A path, SHA, description, memory, or metadata record is not a substitute for pixel readback.
Use the Issue 1 cover reference only for masthead/trade dress: logo proportions, placement, issue-number treatment, issue-title hierarchy, edge clearances, and brand rhythm.
Do not use the Issue 1 cover as composition authority for later covers.
Each later cover must remain compositionally distinct and follow its own assembled recipe.
Character identity references do not control cover layout or promotional typography.
No cover becomes durable reference authority merely because it was generated. It must pass cover reader/thumbnail test, recipe fidelity, character continuity, lettering, and user approval.

references.use: Mandatory pixel-read reference for Issues 2-8 after the Issue 1 cover is approved and persisted.

generationOrder: Approve and persist Issue 1 cover pixels at the declared reference path.
EFW_S1E02_COVER through EFW_S1E08_COVER, each using the approved Issue 1 cover pixels for trade dress only.
completionGate: For Issues 2-8, actual Issue 1 cover pixels inspected in active multimodal context.
One-second dominant hook reads at thumbnail size.
Masthead and issue title are exact, legible, and consistent with the approved Issue 1 cover.
No spoiler beyond the recipe's spoiler ceiling.
No invented promotional or environmental text.
No generic cast lineup or recap collage unless explicitly required by the recipe.
User approval before any cover is promoted to durable production authority.
